content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: MBBS; Internship completion certificate; Permanent Medical Registration (WBMC or MCI), proof of application for registration, or self-declaration in prescribed format Age limit: Maximum 35 years (as on 31st November 2026) Desirable: Preference to fresh candidates completing internship at this institute in 2025-26

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Stipendiary post; no amount printed. Engagement for the period up to 03-05-2027 Extension may be given after satisfactory completion of house-staffship, depending on vacancy as on 04-05-2027

content_sections.heading: How Will MJNMCH Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Document verification Counseling as per eligibility criteria Counseling on 04-11-2026 at 2:00 PM, Conference Hall, Academic Building, MJN Medical College & Hospital, Cooch Behar Only eligible candidates after document verification are allowed for counseling

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Madhyamik or equivalent certificate showing date of birth All mark sheets of MBBS examinations Chance certificate for MBBS examinations Documents of Honours and Gold Medal (if any) Internship completion certificate Permanent Medical Registration Certificate (WBMC or MCI), proof of application, or self-declaration in prescribed format

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MJNMCH Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Apply offline with the attached proforma. Attach self-attested photocopies of the listed documents. Submit the application to the office of the Principal, MJN Medical College & Hospital, Cooch Behar. Submit by 5:00 PM on 02-11-2026. Appear for counseling on 04-11-2026 with all original documents, self-attested photocopies and two recent passport size colour photographs.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: All documents must be self-attested photocopies. Candidates must report at 11:00 AM on 04-11-2026 for counseling.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MJNMCH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 2 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for MJNMCH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Proforma attached to the notice) and send it to Office of the Principal, Maharaja Jitendra Narayan Medical College & Hospital, Vivekananda Street, Pilkhana, Cooch Behar - 736101, by offline, to reach by 2 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for MJNMCH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (as on 31st November 2026).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Stipend.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS with completed internship and permanent or applied medical registration (WBMC or MCI).

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Document verification. Counseling as per eligibility criteria. Counseling on 04-11-2026 at 2:00 PM, Conference Hall, Academic Building, MJN Medical College & Hospital, Cooch Behar. Only eligible candidates after document verification are allowed for counseling.

faq.question: Q7. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement for the period up to 03-05-2027. Extension may be given after satisfactory completion of house-staffship, depending on vacancy as on 04-05-2027.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Cooch Behar.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Madhyamik or equivalent certificate showing date of birth; All mark sheets of MBBS examinations; Chance certificate for MBBS examinations; Documents of Honours and Gold Medal (if any); Internship completion certificate; Permanent Medical Registration Certificate (WBMC or MCI), proof of application, or self-declaration in prescribed format.
